indication.text: Radioactive diagnostic drug indicated for PET myocardial perfusion imaging (MPI) under rest or stress (pharmacologic or exercise) in adult patients with known or suspected coronary artery disease (CAD) to evaluate for myocardial ischemia and infarction

citations.quote: FLYRCADO is indicated for positron emission tomography (PET) myocardial perfusion imaging (MPI) under rest or stress (pharmacologic or exercise) in adult patients with known or suspected coronary artery disease (CAD) to evaluate for myocardial ischemia and infarction.

target_moa.text: Flurpiridaz F 18 is an analog of the mitochondrial complex 1 (MC-1) inhibitor pyridaben; it is extracted by the myocardium proportional to blood flow and binds heart tissue with biologically active mitochondria, so radioactivity in viable myocardium is higher than in infarcted tissue

citations.quote: Flurpiridaz F 18 is an analog of the mitochondrial complex 1 (MC-1) inhibitor, pyridaben. Flurpiridaz F 18 is extracted by the myocardium proportional to the blood flow and binds to heart tissue that has biologically active mitochondria. Therefore, radioactivity in viable myocardium is higher than in infarcted tissue.

modality.text: Radiopharmaceutical (fluorine-18 labeled small molecule); positron-emitting radioactive diagnostic drug
